name: Probe: hlvr.exe entry
description: Counts the game's entry point and logs when it ran; changes nothing else. Checks the guest patch chain.

hooks.name: exe_entry
hooks.evidence: hlvr.exe (Steam build of 2026-10-02 on Swan) PE AddressOfEntryPoint 0x1670: sub rsp,0x28; call 0x18d4 (__security_init_cookie); add rsp,0x28; jmp 0x14fc (__scrt_common_main_seh). MSVC CRT entry, rcx = PEB.
